question: Which office issues the tax documents an organization or a member relies on (the T4A and CRA export, the RL-1 slip, the T106 information return of related-party transactions, the receipt for a political contribution), from which stored records is each document computed, which readers may see the remittance ledger a document is drawn from, and may a member who is not an officer read the amounts the organization remits to its parent body?
decision: No generation of T4A, RL-1, T106, political contribution receipts or other statutory slips in the launch product; endpoints are inaccessible/explicitly unavailable with no false output. Restricted remittance ledgers are visible only to authorized financial-mandate holders, not all officers or members. This does not preclude a properly issued commercial invoice/receipt from the approved external checkout for SaaS or paid ICRA/workbook purchases. Retain historical financial records under applicable schedules and holds.
originalProposedDecision: Not at launch: the platform issues no tax slips, returns or receipts; routes return 501. The remittance ledger is officer-and-above; members cannot read parent-body remittance amounts.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
